spots.name: Terrett Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,076 m (3,530 ft).

spots.name: Moorhead Recreation Area
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 122 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L12616995.

spots.name: West Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,345 m (4,413 ft).

spots.name: Camps Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.
